name: NeRF Ensemble with Conjoint Pruning
definition: An ensemble approach combining two NeRF models (specifically DVGO) of different grid resolutions to improve novel view synthesis performance while maintaining similar parameter counts and memory footprint compared to a single model.
summary: NeRF Ensemble with Conjoint Pruning improves novel view synthesis by combining two NeRF models of different resolutions through independent training, fine-tuning, and conjoint pruning to prevent performance degradation.
